name: execute_python
description: Execute Python code inside the running FreeCAD GUI process. 'App'/'FreeCAD' and 'Gui'/'FreeCADGui' are pre-bound — do not import them. Captured stdout/stderr is returned.

code.description: Python source to execute in the FreeCAD session.

name: execute_python_file
description: Read a local Python file and execute it inside the running FreeCAD GUI process. Same execution context as execute_python.

name: get_output_page
description: Retrieve a page of output for a prior execute call that returned has_more=true. To read forward, pass page_no one higher than the last page_no you received (0 if you received none yet); repeat until has_more=false. Requesting a page_no already received replays it.

job_token.description: Token from a previous execute or get_output_page response.

page_no.description: 0-based index of the page to retrieve.

name: inspect_active_document
description: Read a compact summary of the active FreeCAD document and its shape objects. This is read-only and does not change the viewport.

name: highlight_objects
description: Visibly select named objects in the active FreeCAD document and fit the 3D view around them. This changes selection/view only, not geometry.

object_names.description: Exact internal object names shown in the document tree.
